Definition: Bedan, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Bedan means "in judging." The name is shared by several bearers: A judge who followed Gideon; A Manassite. It turns up in 1 Samuel 12:11 and 1 Chronicles 7:17.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Bedan matters because God remembers names the world forgets.
